description: Present value of a structured settlement, annuity or lottery payment stream at typical buyer discount rates (8% to 18%), and, if a lump-sum offer is given, the effective discount rate that offer implies, the cents on the dollar, and whether it sits in the typical range. With targetAmount, also prices a partial sale (sell only enough payments to raise that amount and keep the rest). Use when someone asks what their payments are worth, whether an offer is fair, or what selling part of their payments would cost.

annualIncreasePct.description: Yearly step-up in the payment, in percent (for example 3 for 3% a year)

count.description: Number of payments left (give this, or years and/or months)

lifeContingent.description: true if the payments stop at the recipient's death

months.description: Extra months of payments left (used with years)

offer.description: Lump sum a buyer has offered for these payments, in US dollars (optional)

payment.description: Amount of each payment in US dollars

startsInMonths.description: Months until the first payment, if the payments have not started yet (default 0)

targetAmount.description: Lump sum wanted from a PARTIAL sale, in US dollars (optional). Returns partial_sale: what it costs to raise this amount by selling the next payments in full, or a slice of every payment, at 8%, 13% and 18%.

years.description: Years of payments left (alternative to count)

name: value_payment_stream
title: Value a payment stream or judge an offer
